### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 8/10" aria-label="Importance 8 of 10">8</span> Russian Missiles Strike Poland Amid Ukraine Conflict; European Response
Two Russian cruise missiles and a jet-powered drone crashed in southeastern Poland on November 20 during NATO military exercises involving 11 nations. NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte called it a "grave violation" of Polish airspace; Polish leaders characterized it as an intentional provocation occurring during the drills.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>November 20, 2026: two cruise missiles and drone crashed in Poland</li>
<li>Incidents in Nowy Lipowiec, Mołodycz, Rudnik nad Sanem, 30–60 miles from exercises</li>
<li>NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte called it &#x27;grave violation&#x27; and &#x27;clearly dangerous&#x27;</li>
<li>Polish PM Donald Tusk characterized it as &#x27;intentional provocation&#x27;</li>
<li>Rutte expected to visit Poland over the weekend</li>
</ul>

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 8/10" aria-label="Importance 8 of 10">8</span> International Court of Justice finds Myanmar guilty of genocide against Rohingya
The UN's highest court has found Myanmar responsible for genocide against the Rohingya, with rights groups calling for immediate sanctions.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>First ICJ genocide verdict in 80-year history</li>
<li>Judges voted 9-6 for genocide finding</li>
<li>August-September 2017 military campaign; estimated ~10,000 Rohingya killed</li>
<li>392 villages burned; ~2,109 estimated child deaths under age 5</li>
</ul>
